description: Systems do not enforce access decisions based on user authorization status. This signal indicates that access may be granted without verifying that users are authorized for the requested resources or operations.
applicability: Applicable to all system access control implementations. Includes authentication systems, authorization mechanisms, and access decision points across applications and infrastructure.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through access control mechanism review, authorization testing, and access decision audit.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
